home.h1: Download video, audio, and images — without limits
home.intro: Loady is a straightforward way to save media you're authorized to access, in the format you actually need. Paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook, and Loady analyzes it, shows you what's available, and lets you choose exactly what to keep.

video.title: Video
video.body: Save a video in a genuinely playable MP4, at the resolution you choose.

audio.title: Audio
audio.body: Pull just the audio track out as MP3 or M4A, at the bitrate you want.

image.title: Images
image.body: Save a single photo, or every item in a multi-photo carousel post.

video.intro: Loady's video downloader takes a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook, and turns it into a file you can keep — for content you own or are otherwise authorized to save.
video.aboutBody: By default, Loady converts what it downloads into a Compatibility MP4: standard H.264 video with AAC audio, so it opens on phones, laptops, and TVs without a fuss. If you'd rather keep the source's original codec and container — which can mean a WebM or MKV file — Loady's Original mode skips the conversion step entirely.
video.qualityBody: Loady lists the resolutions actually available for a given link, from standard definition up through the source's best quality. Signed-out visitors and Free accounts can save up to 720p; higher resolutions, including 4K where the source provides it, are available on paid plans.

steps.title: Paste a link
steps.body: Drop in a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook video URL.

steps.title: Pick a quality
steps.body: Loady shows the resolutions available for that specific video.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Your file is prepared and ready to save in a few moments.

faq.a: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook video links.
No — you can analyze a link and complete your first two downloads without signing up. A free account removes that limit.

faq.q: What file format do I get?
faq.a: An MP4 by default (Compatibility mode). You can switch to Original mode to keep the source's native container instead.
4K is available where the source provides it, on Pro and Creator plans. Free accounts and guests are limited to 720p.

audio.intro: Sometimes you just want the sound, not the picture. Loady's audio downloader extracts the audio track from a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook link and saves it as a standalone audio file.
audio.aboutBody: Loady can save the audio as an MP3 at a bitrate you choose — 128, 192, 256, or 320 kbps — or as an M4A file using the source's original audio codec, when you'd rather avoid a second layer of compression.
audio.qualityBody: A higher MP3 bitrate preserves more detail at the cost of a larger file. 192 kbps is a solid, widely-compatible default; 320 kbps is closer to the source recording for critical listening.

steps.title: Paste a link
steps.body: Drop in the link of a video you want the audio from.

steps.title: Choose audio
steps.body: Switch to the Audio tab and pick MP3 or M4A, plus a bitrate.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Loady extracts and saves just the audio track.

faq.q: Can I get just the audio from a video link?
faq.a: Yes — paste the video's link and switch to the Audio tab; Loady extracts the audio track for you.

faq.q: MP3 or M4A — what's the difference?
faq.a: MP3 is the most universally compatible format. M4A can preserve the source's original audio codec without re-encoding, which some listeners prefer.
192 kbps is a good default for everyday listening. Choose 320 kbps if you want audio closer to the original source.

faq.q: Do guests get audio downloads too?
faq.a: Yes — audio downloads count toward the same free guest allowance as video and image downloads.

image.intro: Not every link is a video. Loady also recognizes image posts and multi-photo carousel posts, and saves them at their original resolution.
image.aboutBody: Paste the link to a single image post and Loady saves the full-resolution photo directly. For a carousel post — one that holds several photos and videos together, common on Instagram — Loady lists every item individually, so you can save just the ones you want, or all of them at once.
image.qualityBody: Image downloads skip the video pipeline entirely: no conversion, no quality ladder to choose from — just the best available copy of the image, saved as-is.

steps.title: Paste a link
steps.body: Drop in the link to an image or carousel post.

steps.title: Review the items
steps.body: For a carousel, Loady lists each photo and video in the post.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Save one item, several, or the entire post at once.

faq.q: Does Loady support Instagram carousel posts?
faq.a: Yes — Loady detects multi-item carousel posts and lets you choose which photos and videos to save.
Loady saves the best available copy of the image, without extra compression.

faq.q: Does an image count as one download?
faq.a: Yes. In a carousel, each item you save counts individually toward your plan's allowance.

faq.q: Do I need an account to save an image?
faq.a: No — image downloads work with the same free guest allowance as video and audio.
